scope: New/modified files, firmware BIN/ELF, and unpacked distribution archive members
credential_checks: No full PEM private keys, GitHub tokens, AWS keys, credential URLs, real provisioning headers, NVS/Flash dumps, runtime registries or private inventory included.
reviewed_matches: PEM BEGIN markers are NUL-terminated SDK parser strings, with no key body.
Device identifiers in two modified test files already occur in the published base with the same counts; retained fixtures, not new operational records.
Test password literals are synthetic USB fixture values.
Email addresses in third-party notices are required attribution; not operator personal records.
ELF retains original toolchain/SDK debug paths.
